items.title: File Widerspruch against refusal of tree-felling exemption
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie innerhalb eines Monats nach seiner Bekanntgabe Widerspruch einlegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Behörde: Landkreis Musterpeene, Kreishausweg 1, 17109 Musterdemmin.
items.computation: Letter dated Thursday 19.11.2026; assuming posting (Aufgabe zur Post) on the same day. The letter cites its own delivery-fiction rule: 'gilt am vierten Tag nach der Aufgabe zur Post als bekannt gegeben' (§ 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG M-V, as quoted — note this differs from the usual 'dritter Tag' wording found in most VwVfG versions). Counting the 4th day after 19.11.2026: 20.11 (Fri, day 1), 21.11 (Sat, day 2), 22.11 (Sun, day 3), 23.11 (Mon, day 4) -> deemed Bekanntgabe = Monday, 23.11.2026 (not itself a weekend/holiday, so no shift needed). The one-month Widerspruch period then runs per §§ 187 Abs.1, 188 Abs.2 BGB: the day of Bekanntgabe (23.11.) is not counted (§187 Abs.1), and the period ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number, i.e. 23.12.2026. 23.12.2026 is a Wednesday and not a public holiday in MV, so no further shift applies. Final deadline: 23.12.2026.

warnings: The letter states the postal-delivery fiction as 'am vierten Tag nach der Aufgabe zur Post' (4th day), whereas the standard wording in § 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG (and most Länder's equivalents) is 'am dritten Tag' (3rd day); this may be a drafting inconsistency in the letter — verify the exact wording of the applicable MV provision, as if it is in fact the third day, the Widerspruch deadline would instead be 22.12.2026.

The exact date on which the letter was actually posted (Aufgabe zur Post) is not stated separately and was assumed to be the same as the document date (19.11.2026); if postal dispatch occurred later, the deadline shifts accordingly.
